# What agentic.check recommends but no zencq repository uses. `agentic.check --yes` installs every recommendation and
# doesn't remember what was deselected before, so ../agentic-check.yml removes these afterwards with
# ../scripts/agentic-check-skip.sh. A repository skips more in a file of the same path and format, its own
# .github/workflows/config/agentic-check-skip.txt.
#
# directive:<name>  a directive block in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md (<!-- name:start --> ... <!-- name:end -->)
# skill:<name>      a skill folder in every skills directory (.agents/skills/<name>, .claude/skills/<name>, ...)
# badge             the "built with: dna" badge in README.md

directive:foundation-prompt-log

badge
